title: Refrigerant Allowance Valuation Sheet — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Settlement.** The Comfort Club refrigerant allowance on Repair and Emergency Service Calls is settled call by call. On each completed call for a Comfort Club member whose agreement is active, the refrigerant allowance pounds are the pounds of refrigerant allowance that the member's tier lists. No pounds are carried between calls. A customer without an active agreement has no refrigerant allowance.

**Pounds covered.** The pounds covered are the smaller of two figures: the pounds billed on the call's refrigerant lines, and the refrigerant allowance pounds. The result is rounded to one decimal place.

**Billed price per pound.** The billed price per pound is the amount of the call's refrigerant lines divided by their pounds. Where every pound on the call was R-410A, this is the class's R-410A price per pound from the refrigerant price list.

**Value.** The allowance is worth the pounds covered multiplied by the billed price per pound, rounded once at the end to the cent half up. Amounts are carried at full precision until the single rounding. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent; for this purpose an amount within 1e-09 of a dollar below the half cent counts as exactly halfway.

**Posting.** The allowance is posted as one member refrigerant allowance line naming the refrigerant line and the agreement.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Whether the agreement is active | The member's Comfort Club agreement record |
| Pounds billed | Quantity on the call's refrigerant lines |
| Amount billed | Amount on the call's refrigerant lines |
| Refrigerant allowance pounds | The refrigerant allowance pounds per term listed for the member's Comfort Club tier |

## Worked examples (hypothetical calls and tier figures)

| Example | Refrigerant billed on the call | Tier pounds (illustrative) | Billed price per pound | Pounds covered | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3.0 pounds R-410A, $267.00 | 1.0 | $267.00 divided by 3.0, $89.00 | 1.0 | $89.00 |
| B | 1.5 pounds R-454B, $168.00 | 2.0 | $112.00 | 1.5 (the billed pounds are smaller) | $168.00 |
| C | 2.0 pounds R-410A at $178.00 and 1.0 pound R-22 at $165.00, together 3.0 pounds and $343.00 | 2.0 | $343.00 divided by 3.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 multiplied by $343.00 divided by 3.0, which is $228.666…, posted as $228.67 |
| D | 2.0 pounds R-410A, $178.00, agreement lapsed | — | — | — | None; no active agreement |

In example C the price per pound is not rounded on its own. The single rounding comes at the end, on the value of the pounds covered.

## Call by call

A member with two completed calls in the same term is figured afresh on each call from the tier's pounds. Pounds not used on the first call do not pass to the second, and pounds used on the first call do not reduce the second.
